title: Redis Cache OOM Crash & Mass Eviction
summary: Redis master pod crashed due to Out Of Memory condition caused by unbounded session token caching.
symptoms: Redis pod restarted 4 times in 15 minutes
Cache hit ratio dropped from 94% to 12%
root_cause: Session token TTL was set to infinity in new feature release causing Redis memory usage to reach maxmemory threshold without eviction policy.
resolution: Set volatile-lru eviction policy and updated session store with explicit 24-hour TTL.
